mechanism_narrative: The week-over-week rebound in WORKPLACES from -43.1 to -22.3 signals that commuting and office activity are recovering from the Omicron trough; this raises weekday retail footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES continues to rise but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is below the last 28-day mean of -22.1.

mechanism_narrative: High GROCERY_PHARM (+8.6) combined with elevated RESIDENTIAL (+8.7) indicates households are still consolidating trips and staying home, which crowds out discretionary retail visits; RETAIL_REC therefore falls over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM > 5 and RESIDENTIAL > 5 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds -22.1.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT weekly mean below -25 signals suppressed station usage and reduced trip chaining; while this threshold is breached, retail trips that depend on transit access remain weak, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT stays below -25 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of active capacity restrictions (WORKPLACES below -20 and RESIDENTIAL above +8), retail venues face reduced allowed occupancy and consumer caution; RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks as restrictions bind.
failure_condition: If the restriction regime holds but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is above -22.1.

mechanism_narrative: The post-holiday January retail trough is seasonal and mean-reverting; after four weeks of depressed RETAIL_REC (mean -22.1), typical early-February normalization raises retail visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is below -22.1 despite the seasonal normalization window.

mechanism_narrative: Policy-driven reductions in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES reduce the daily population circulating through commercial districts; when both series remain below their recent thresholds, retail and recreation visits fall over the next week.
failure_condition: If both thresholds are breached but RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is above the last 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling below -10 indicates that out-of-home leisure is being curtailed; because park visits often co-travel with nearby retail stops, further declines in PARKS pull RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -10 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds -22.1.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM indicates continued essential-trip concentration and possible illness-driven shopping; this essential orientation leaves less discretionary capacity for RETAIL_REC, which declines over the next week.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above +5 but RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is above the last 7-day mean.
